title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Donuts Lemon Drizzle 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy Vape Co.’s Seriously Donuts Lemon Drizzle e-liquid is a vibrant bakery flavour profile that balances warm pastry notes with a tangy citrus kick. The inhale offers the familiar taste of soft, fluffy Donut dough, which is instantly lifted by a sharp and zesty Lemon centre. Hints of frosted Lemon icing rounds out the exhale, creating a comforting yet refreshing dessert profile. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mod kits and sub-ohm tanks .
